get_hook_name: get the human-readable hook name from a hook ID using the HOOK_MAP reverse lookup
get_hashes: compute SHA1 hashes of a file's raw contents and its CRLF-normalized contents
create_HOOK_MAP: build a reverse lookup dictionary mapping hook objects to their string names from the hooks module
review_get_hook_name: review the get_hook_name function to understand how it resolves hook IDs to human-readable names
refactor_get_hashes: refactor the get_hashes function to support additional hash algorithms beyond SHA1
